video_frame_map: Each row has video_frame 0..599, increasing native_frame and time_s. bus_motion.jsonl joins the same original native_frame and video_frame.
bus_motion: Each row contains post-tick original Native velocity_mps [vx, vy, vz] and source_kind original_native_velocity. Requested controller speed is never substituted.
passenger_review: An independent reviewer must bind all four camera file SHA-256 hashes, confirm the actual bus asset/class and visible pupils aboard, record observed_pupil_count with original evidence frames, and cite trip_purpose_source for the school transport purpose. A diagnostic fixture is labeled synthetic_diagnostic and cannot establish these physical facts.
comparison_variable: speed request only; actual observed speeds may differ
unverified_native_dependency: The installed CARLA asset catalogue must identify a genuine school bus model and an ice cream truck. No candidate blueprint string is asserted as a confirmed school bus.
